newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Western Reefs sees rise in gold output.
newsitem.headline: Western Reefs sees rise in gold output.

text.p: Western Reefs Ltd said on Thursday total gold output from its 49.9 percent-owned Dalgaranga mine in Western Australia rose 18 percent to 15,305 ounces in the June quarter from the previous three months.
Average cash costs over the same period fell to A$298 an ounce from A$320 an ounce.
Western Reefs said it has sold 70,000 ounces of gold forward at an average price of A$575 an ounce.
Both milling and mining at the mine exceeded expectations, the company said.
Equigold NL owns the remaining 50.1 percent in Dalgaranga.
Western Reefs also said it had finalised an agrreement to merge with Trimark Mining Corp (TMC) of the Philippines.

Western Reefs in June said the merger was aimed at providing the company with an operating base in which to negotiate a minimum of 10 joint ventures in properties on the island of Mindanao in the Philippines prospective for gold, copper and nickel.
Western Reefs is listed on the Australian and Berlin stock exchanges.
